slots.title: The Touch He Gave Back
slots.summary: FIE Annual Awards (Budapest, Sunday): world junior No. 1 Kruz Schembri (U.S. Virgin Islands, 20) shares the 2026 Fair Play Trophy for refusing a touch at 13–13 against Davide Di Veroli at the Senior Worlds; he lost 15–13. Co-winner: French armorer Gilles Martinage, who fixed his failed blades. Adds the season's epee No. 1s (Santuccio, Elsayed, Prošina). From FIE's own articles.
